= camel test run

Run as local Citrus test

NOTE: This command is provided by the `test` plugin. Install it with `camel plugin add test`.


== Usage

[source,bash]
----
camel test run [options]
----



== Options

[cols="2,5,1,2",options="header"]
|===
| Option | Description | Default | Type
| `--dep,--dependency` | Comma delimited list of additional Maven GAV dependencies that must be loaded to run the test. |  | List
| `--engine` | Name of the test engine that is used to run tests. One of junit, junit-jupiter, junit4, testng, cucumber |  | String
| `--includes` | Includes test name pattern. |  | List
| `--inspect-code` | When enabled the source code gets analyzed for required modules and dependencies that are added to the classpath. | true | boolean
| `--logging` | Can be used to turn off logging | true | boolean
| `--logging-color` | Use colored logging | true | boolean
| `--logging-level` | Logging level | info | String
| `--modules` | Comma delimited list of additional Citrus modules that must be loaded to run the test. |  | String
| `--offline` | When enabled there will be no attempts to resolve Maven artifacts via internet connection. | false | boolean
| `--property,--properties` | Default System property to set before the test run. |  | List
| `--repository,--repositories` | Set of Maven repositories that should be used to resolve dependencies. |  | List
| `--reset` | Should the test engine reset the suite state for this run. | true | String
| `--verbose` | Should the test engine print verbose test summary information. | true | String
| `--work-directory` | The working directory used by the file based test engines to load file resources from. |  | String
| `-h,--help` | Display the help and sub-commands |  | boolean
|===
